scope: A local Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind API server only. Use four ordinary GET /version requests and two named kube-scheduler Lease requests total, before and after a narrow FlowSchema. Capture only APF classification response headers and bounded response identity, plus passive seat and dispatch metrics. No synthetic contention or rejection is induced. This does not assess production or managed control planes, traffic under load, tenant fairness, or provider defaults. A bounded passive log observer reports naturally occurring kubelet Lease updates and the real scheduler named-Lease request classification; raw API-server logs are discarded.

checks.claim: Kubernetes v1.36 serves the stable APF API; effective flags follow APF capacity semantics

observed.capacity_semantics: summed under APF; separate limits only when APF is disabled

The ordinary runner administrator request follows the built-in global default
An ordinary read of the scheduler lease keeps its leader-election priority
The exact ServiceAccount and GET /version request route to the dedicated limited priority
A bounded request increments the dedicated dispatch and wait histogram counters under the live queue configuration
The narrow identity rule leaves ordinary administrator classification unchanged
The exact synthetic-subject schema does not change kube-scheduler leader-election routing
Completed native kubelet Lease writes use the expected APF priority
Completed native kube-scheduler Lease writes use the expected APF priority
